principle_violations.reason: The Order class is handling the list of items, quantities, prices, and status, mixing the responsibility of managing order data and status. The pay methods in payment processors are also responsible for changing the order status, which should be handled through the order itself to make the payment processing solely focused on transactions.
principle_violations.suggestion: The Order class should delegate payment status updates to the payment processors, potentially introducing methods like 'markAsPaid' in the Order class itself. This allows the responsibility of status management to be clearly within the Order class.

overall_feedback: 1 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
